body: Self-caught after landing the first pass: BACKLOG.md's own SECTION 146 documents gpt2-alpine-c's Python prototype (S146-02, scripts/prime_directive_dataset.py) as the established contract fabledata should inherit, and that prototype gates on confirmed-only -- my Go v0 wrongly included contradicts too. A contradicts verdict means the extraction got the headline wrong; training on it would teach a generator to reproduce the error, not grade it against reality. Fixed: BuildExamples now returns (examples, Stats, error), only confirmed cases are included, contradicts/pending both excluded and counted separately (not silently dropped, matching the spec's own Lobian rule 1 language). Re-verified live: 0 confirmed, 39 excluded-pending, 0 contradicts, correct given the current corpus state. All 11 tests updated and green, go build/vet/test ./... clean. Commit 5743e97.
title: S145-01 follow-up: fabledata verdict gating corrected to confirmed-only
